title: Sync through the site
description: Your profiles on every PC: the manager keeps them on triotmetki.ru under your account and brings them back on another computer.
pending: {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}} not sent
updated: Synced: changes from the site applied
linkHint: The same binding as the mod: get a code in your account on the site (the mod section) and enter it here. The manager never asks for your Lesta password.
linkSite: Get a code on the site
linked: The manager is linked to your site account
privacy: Only profile names, their component lists and settings go to the site — never the binding code, the statistics upload or other privacy switches. You can delete the copy on the site from your account.
conflictTitle: Changes here and on the site
conflictDescription: Since the last sync your profiles changed both on this PC and on another one. Choose what to keep.

merge.label: Merge
merge.hint: Each profile keeps its newer version; what was deleted on one side is deleted on the other

keep_local.label: Keep mine
keep_local.hint: The site gets exactly what is on this PC now

take_remote.label: Take the site copy
take_remote.hint: This PC gets what is on the site now; its own changes are lost

validation.code: Enter the code from the site: 10 letters and digits
